ana: Quick note: switching sampleapp to new batcher helper (v2) exposed two issues: (1) manifest-declared dim differs from actual embedding length; (2) retries after auth refresh caused duplicate rerank processing.

mike: Can you paste error?

ana: Runtime error: VectorDimensionMismatch expected=1536 manifest but got=1024 in body.

jin: Manifest comes from onboarding build step; quantization changed returned dim. SDKs must validate body vectors, not trust manifest.

tara: On retry path we re-send same HTTP body immediately after RefreshToken(). Batcher v2 didn't add an idempotency header so server processed batch twice. Seen in customer logs.

mike: Proposal: SDKs (node/py/go) should: validate per-vector length and warn if manifest differs; set X-Client-Batch-Id=uuid for batched calls; on 401 do refresh+backoff then retry preserving batch id.

jin: I'll add unit tests for inconsistent dims and an integration that simulates 401 then asserts single server-side processing when batch id present.

ana: Repro steps in case helpful: checkout sampleapp@feat/batcher-v2, start staging, POST bad_batch.json (vectors length 1024 but manifest says 1536) with short-lived token.

devx-bot: CI run: rerank/batcher.integration failed (shape mismatch + duplicate processing).

tara: I'll open PRs for node/python and ping go for parity. Will add onboarding tip to write model_reported_dim in console (informational only).

mike: Also include clear error text for Sentry: 'VectorDimensionMismatch: manifest=1536 body=1024' so support can search.

ana: Thanks all, will track PRs and add a minimal repro file to the PR.
